Position Overview: The Boeing India Engineering is looking for a Lead – FPGA Design Engineer with proven industry expertise in delivering end-to-end FPGA designs , for Electronics Product team located at Bengaluru, India. Boeing India Engineering oversees the design, development, manufacture, integration and testing of LRU design and analysis for various Avionics systems. Position Responsibilities : Lead complex FPGA/SoC design from concept to production. Own FPGA Architecture development and design strategy across the projects. Define FPGA design methodologies, coding standards and best practices. Lead the RTL development (using Verilog / SystemVerilog) efforts. Lead and mentor a team of FPGA engineers, drive design reviews and help in capability building. Proactively manage risks, dependencies and plan effective mitigations. Demonstrates problem solving skills to resolve technical issues on architectural approaches, requirements, specifications and design. Drives the design quality, KPI measures, documentation and compliance to industry standards such as DO-254 (DAL A/B/C/D as applicable) or equivalent. Leads activities in support of Supplier Management with make/buy recommendations and other technical services. Effectively collaborate with cross functional teams and leadership. Evaluates and integrates third-party IP and verification IP (VIP). Stay ahead on new technologies and standard processes. Deliver upon Stage Gate Reviews, establish processes and drive design excellence. Conducts technical training, allocates tasks, review deliverables and ensures productivity. Possess strong ownership and accountability, has ability to influence and drive technical decisions. Excellent problem-solving, analytical thinking and communication skills. Coordinates engineering support throughout the lifecycle of the product. Plans research projects to develop concepts for future product designs to meet projected requirements. Works under minimal direction. Basic Qualifications ( Required Skills / Experience ): Bachelor degree in Engineering, Engineering Technology (including Manufacturing Technology), Electronics, Electrical, Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, or non-US equivalent qualifications directly related to the work statement. Proven experience in RTL design using Verilog/System Verilog and perform synthesis, place & route, timing closure and optimization. Experience on high-speed interfaces design such as PCIe, DDR, Ethernet, SerDes, etc. Proven experience in designing digital ASIC/FPGA architectural design documents (micro-architecture documents with timing diagrams, detailed design blocks, etc.). Experience deriving digital ASIC/FPGA requirements specification from higher-level (system or board-level) requirements specifications.
